_comment: Golden queries for check-retrieval.mjs. Each entry is a question a real reader would ask, plus `expect`: a substring that MUST appear in the source_name of at least one of the top `k` retrieved chunks. Deliberately anchored on the CASE STUDIES and OPEN DATA, because those are the two things the product's pitch rests on and the two that failed silently for a month in 2026-07. Keep questions phrased the way a user types them, not the way the document is written — retrieval that only works when you quote the document back at it is not retrieval. Add a case whenever a retrieval bug is found, so the same bug cannot return unnoticed.

queries.q: why did India nearly default in 1991 and what did it have to pledge
what happens when a country pegs its currency and runs out of reserves
how did the Fed break inflation in the early 1980s
when did the dollar stop being convertible into gold
how did Greece end up needing a bailout
what did governments do to the economy during covid
is there a historical parallel for a sudden stop in capital flows
India GDP growth rate recent years
how much does India hold in foreign exchange reserves
inflation in the United States over the last few years
current account deficit as a share of GDP
